newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE May cocoa falls more than 5.0 pct, NY weak.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE May cocoa falls more than 5.0 pct, NY weak.

text.p: LIFFE May cocoa futures fell more than 5.0 percent in early afternoon trade as cocoa futures in New York opened sharply lower on fund liquidation.
At 1340 GMT, May cocoa futures were down 65 stg at 979 stg per tonne.
LIFFE May cocoa fell to the lowest level since March 10 and completely filled two gaps on its daily bar charts.
New York cocoa futures gapped lower at the open and hit sell-stops in May near $1,350 and $1,400.
CSCE cocoa was also pressured by speculators and funds liquidating or rolling May positions to move into July before first notice day on April 17, traders said.
May open interest in New York was a hefty 30,254 lots as of April 3.

Germany's 11.71-percent drop in its first-quarter cocoa grind to 61,379.3 tonnes from year-ago levels and heavy late-March rains in the Ivory Coast, which favours Ivorian mid-crop prospects, also pressured cocoa.
